posting.title: 🤖 Clone & Ship 100+ Free AI Agents From One Repo
posting.caption: You can now clone and ship over a hundred AI agents. Awesome LLM Apps is Apache-2.0 licensed with over 143,000 stars: agent skills, RAG apps, voice agents and multi-agent teams, all tested end-to-end. They run on Claude, Gemini, GPT, DeepSeek, Llama or Qwen. Install a skill in one command, or run any agent in thirty seconds. One skill even autopsies your abandoned side projects. Rude, but fair. Comment the word 'AGENTS' and I'll send you the link and tutorial for this repo.
posting.linkedin:
🤖 What if you could stop building AI agents from scratch?

Most people spend weeks wiring up agents, RAG pipelines and voice bots before they even test an idea.

Awesome LLM Apps gives you over 100 hand-built, tested AI agents you can clone and ship today:

✅ Agent skills that install with one command and work in Claude Code, Codex and Cursor
✅ Starter, advanced and always-on AI agents
✅ Multi-agent teams, voice AI agents and RAG apps
✅ Generative UI, MCP agents and autonomous game-playing agents
✅ Works with Claude, Gemini, GPT, DeepSeek, Llama or Qwen
✅ Every skill passes a security + eval CI gate

One skill, Project Graveyard, finds every side project you abandoned, tells you why it died, and helps you finish the one worth saving. Rude, but fair.

143,596 stars. Apache-2.0 licensed. New templates drop weekly.

Run an agent in about 30 seconds:
git clone https://github.com/Shubhamsaboo/awesome-llm-apps.git

Which agent would you ship first? 👇
